payload.summary: 33 mutants survived. 8 are real gaps in the version tests: add eight conversion cases to src/katatay/release.test.mjs (a numeric pre-release such as 1.0.0-1 and 1.0.0-10, an identifier such as 1a, later identifiers such as rc.10, rc.2b and rc.beta, a count of 12 commits, and a description with text before the v). 17 survived only because the two regular expressions in release.mjs are built once when the module loads, so Stryker never switched them on: re-applying each one by hand against the existing test cases changes a result. Moving the regexes into releaseFromDescription would let mutation measure them, but that is an implementation change and needs a revised plan; the operator decides whether it is worth one. The other 8 have no observable effect: an empty encoding or stdio entry gives Node's defaults, which read the same text, and git describe reads no stdin. Optionally assert the staged package.json ends with a newline.
